notes.title: Steam Next Fest Demo Released
notes.content:
Play the Origami Ninja Star demo for free now!

The demo includes the main introduction, tutorial level, first procedural generation level (Void Level) with roguelike mechanics, and first boss fight.

The focus of the demo is the movement and combat mechanics, mastering these will enable you to overcome the first Void Level.

A lot of work has gone into this and we look forward to your feedback!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1147910/Origami_Ninja_Star/
